english.title: Use a hoarding / similar structure which was not securely fixed
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used a hoarding or similar structure that

(A)_[was in]_
(B)_[adjoined]_

a street, namely **(..SPECIFY STREET..), and which was not securely fixed to the satisfaction of **(..SPECIFY AUTHORITY..), the appropriate authority for the purposes of section 172 of the Highways Act 1980
english.legislation: Contrary to section 173(2) of the Highways Act 1980.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
contravene s.173
use hoarding / similar structure
adjoining a street
which was not securely fixed
to the satisfaction of the council

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Proceedings for this offence shall not without the written consent of the Attorney General, be taken by any person other than the person aggrieved, or a highway authority or council having an interest in the enforcement of the provision or byelaws in question - section 312 Highways Act 1980.
(ii) The meaning of "highway" is defined in section 328 Highways Act 1980.
english.standardstatementoffacts:

a street, namely **(..SPECIFY STREET..), and which was not securely fixed to the satisfaction of **(..SPECIFY AUTHORITY..), the appropriate authority for the purposes of section 172 of the Highways Act 1980.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level one on the standard scale and if the offence is continued after conviction he is guilty of a further offence and to a further fine of £1 for each day on which the offence continues.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
